tool.name: ChronAeon AutoClock
tool.description: Unsupervised multi-clock community deconvolution and outlier triage
tool.command: #if $input_source.kind == "alignment": ln -s '$input_source.input_file' input.$input_source.input_file.extension && #end if #if $weights: ln -s '$weights' local_weights.pt && #end if chronaeon autoclock #if $input_source.kind == "beast": --beast '$input_source.beast' #else: --alignment input.$input_source.input_file.extension #end if @DATES_METADATA@ --max-k $max_k --manifold '$manifold' #if $weights: --weights local_weights.pt #end if #if $kernel_bandwidth: --kernel-bandwidth $kernel_bandwidth #end if --min-cluster-size $min_cluster_size $hierarchical --max-depth $max_depth --min-leaf-size $min_leaf_size --min-delta-aicc $min_delta_aicc #if str($n_landmarks) != "auto": --n-landmarks $n_landmarks #end if --max-memory-mb "\${GALAXY_MEMORY_MB:-1024}" --rooting-mode '$rooting_mode' $no_dyads --dyad-max-days $dyad_max_days --dyad-max-dist $dyad_max_dist #if $plot: --plot --plot-path chronaeon_autoclock_plot.pdf #end if #if $output_json: --output autoclock_summary.json #end if #if $output_csv: --csv '$csv_output' #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input codon alignment
param.help: An in-frame codon alignment in FASTA or NEXUS format

param.label: Max clock communities
param.help: Maximum candidate number of clock communities to evaluate

param.help: A PyTorch .pt checkpoint containing model weights and architecture config. Leave empty to use the default model. To see available model variants, run the 'HyphAeon List Models' tool.

param.label: Kernel bandwidth (optional)
param.help: Spectral affinity kernel bandwidth sigma (default: adaptive 10th percentile)

param.label: Min cluster size
param.help: Minimum community size to consider a valid clock branch

param.label: Hierarchical deconvolution
param.help: Enable recursive hierarchical multi-clock community deconvolution

param.label: Max recursion depth
param.help: Maximum recursion depth for hierarchical deconvolution

param.label: Min leaf size
param.help: Minimum leaf community size for hierarchical deconvolution

param.label: Min delta AICc
param.help: Minimum AICc improvement required to justify splitting a subcommunity

param.label: Number of landmarks
param.help: 'auto' or integer for Nyström low-rank approximation

param.label: Rooting mode
param.help: Rooting mode for tree-free root-to-tip divergence anchoring

param.label: Dyad max days
param.help: Maximum sampling interval in days for contemporaneous transmission dyads

param.label: Dyad max distance
param.help: Maximum TN93 distance for contemporaneous transmission dyads

tool.help:
ChronAeon AutoClock: Multi-Clock Community Deconvolution ==========================================================
**What question does this method answer?**
Does the sample contain multiple molecular clock regimes (e.g., from different transmission chains or sub-epidemics), and if so, how many communities and what are their respective clock rates?
**How it works**
ChronAeon AutoClock performs unsupervised spectral partitioning of sequences into clock communities using neural latent representations or analytic TN93 distances. It evaluates candidate community counts (K=1..max_k) via AICc and optionally performs recursive hierarchical deconvolution. Contemporaneous transmission dyad screening identifies direct transmission pairs and point-source clusters.
**Inputs**
- An in-frame codon alignment (FASTA or NEXUS), or a BEAST XML carrying sequences and tip dates - Optional sampling dates metadata - Optional local model weights (.pt); the default model is used if omitted. To see available model variants, run the 'HyphAeon List Models' tool.
**Outputs**
- **JSON**: community assignments, per-community clock rates, dyad screening results - **CSV**: classified metadata with community labels - **Plot (PDF)**: optional diagnostic figure
